global.description: Global values to be accessed by all (sub)charts.

customer.description: Local override for the customer name (falls back to global.apc.customer). Used as the customerName alert label.

cluster.description: Local override for cluster values (falls back to global.apc.cluster).

isHub.description: Local override for whether this is the hub cluster (falls back to global.apc.cluster.isHub). The AlertingRule is only rendered when true.

nameOverride.description: Overrides chart name used for app.kubernetes.io/name.

apc-global-overrides.description: Values for the apc-global-overrides dependency chart.
